title: health reports the wrong version, and the member record page logs meta/object 404s for sys_business_unit and sys_comment_reaction
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

## What is wrong
1. Row 254 (record #33096 · 6851700388): `GET /api/v1/health` answered `version: 18.3.0` on the `8e3d4a54` tree, which was already 18.4. Monitoring and operators read this value.
2. Row 160 (records #33058 · 6846283471, #33093 · 6850899929), item `approvals.record-page-decisions`: a member opening a record page logs 404 on `meta/object/sys_business_unit` and `meta/object/sys_comment_reaction`. This is the same class as #32955, which is closed: a non-admin read of system-object metadata answers 404. The page still works, but the console fills with errors, and a component that needs those objects may lose its data quietly.

## Do
1. Read the health version from the same source as the published package version. Pin it against `package.json`.
2. Check whether the #32955 fix covers every system object that a stock record page reads for a member. Close the gap for these two, or make the page skip them for a member.

## Grade
**p2** each.

## Reader
`domain:server`, pilot **Area A4** (health) for 1 and **Area E1** (metadata reads) for 2. Split this card if the two areas want separate cards.
